stateRules.rule: A source’s own published totals or declared coverage disagree.
At least one accepted row lacks an amount, canonical date, recipient name, purpose, or direct source URL.
No row-level contradiction is open, but material publication or interpretation limits apply.

rowRules.current: A current row has last_seen_at equal to its source retrieval timestamp.
rowRules.disappeared: A disappeared row was present in an earlier accepted snapshot but is absent from the current one; this is not called a retraction without publisher evidence.
rowRules.grouped: Grouped status is counted only when a row explicitly carries it. Publisher-wide grouping caveats remain separate.
rowRules.amounts: Dollar totals are computed only inside one selected publisher ledger. Cross-publisher totals are prohibited because the same underlying funding may appear in more than one publication.

ledgers.label: Coefficient public index
caveats: Public entries can lag grantmaking by months and omit sensitive grants.
The public database omits most funding advised for donors other than Good Ventures.
Some source entries group similar grants, but grouping is not exposed consistently enough to infer row-level grouped status.

ledgers.label: GiveWell grant export
ledgers.statusSemantics: published grant; recommendation and payment timing not inferred
caveats: Publication does not establish payment timing.
The public export names funding pools, but those labels are not normalized as originating-funder organizations.
A row-level source URL is not published for every grant.

ledgers.label: Giving Green 2025 cycle
ledgers.statusSemantics: planned Giving Green Fund grant announced for the 2025–2026 recommendation cycle; announcement is not proof of disbursement
caveats: The accepted table announces planned grants; it is not proof of payment or a disbursement date.
Grant size is not an effectiveness ranking or an organization funding gap.

ledgers.label: RenPhil AI for Math
ledgers.statusSemantics: published award; amount and payment timing not published
caveats: Row-level award amounts and decision or payment dates are not published.
Two current award pages do not expose structured team names; source-listed project records remain accepted.

knownIssues.title: GiveWell displayed and exported totals differ
knownIssues.description: The Airtable display is $2,625,949,861; exported rows sum to $2,625,949,864. Both remain visible.

knownIssues.title: RenPhil declared and linked portfolios do not reconcile
knownIssues.description: RenPhil states 29 first-round awards while the current winners page exposes 28 linked records.

knownIssues.title: Coefficient includes a future-dated award row
knownIssues.description: The date is retained as published rather than rewritten; users can inspect the source record.

knownIssues.title: Coefficient public coverage is intentionally partial
knownIssues.description: Sensitive grants may be withheld, publication can lag, and most non–Good Ventures advised funding is outside the public database.

knownIssues.title: Grouped-grant status is not reliably machine-observable
knownIssues.description: Coefficient says some entries group similar grants. Zero observed grouped flags must not be interpreted as zero grouped grants.

knownIssues.title: The EGC subset is excluded from portfolio totals
knownIssues.description: All 79 rows already occur in the complete Coefficient public index. Including this ledger would duplicate source records and amounts.

knownIssues.title: Giving Green rows are announced plans, not verified payments
knownIssues.description: All 29 accepted rows preserve the announcement semantics and leave disbursement dates unpublished.

knownIssues.title: A period-specific funding gap is stale
knownIssues.description: Giving Green’s Project InnerSpace figure is retained with its 2025 period and excluded from current numeric room.

knownIssues.title: A published funding route is closed or contact-required
knownIssues.description: The Founders Pledge opportunity remains visible but is excluded from open funding room.
